chunks: Ali ibn Ibrahim, from Muhammad ibn Isa ibn Ubayd, from Yunus, from Sama'ah, who said:
I heard Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) saying: 'Any believer who walks with his believing brother regarding a need but does not advise him, has betrayed Allah and His Messenger.'
ai.seo_question: What is the consequence for a believer who fails to advise his brother in a time of need?
ai.summary: In al-Kafi, Shaykh al-Kulayni records this narration from Imam al-Sadiq (AS) to highlight that mere physical accompaniment is insufficient without the spiritual duty of sincere counsel (nasiha). This failure constitutes a breach of covenant with Allah and the Prophet, underscoring the communal responsibility of believers to guide one another in both worldly and religious affairs.
